lean.name: Formalism.LFunctionChainParameters.MatrixLatticeEstimates.InputSG
lean.note: For each period map, the diagonal Gram block measures how far the weighted map is from an isometry. The other two tests bound the overlap of distinct maps on the scale $d_i d_j/D^*$ and cap the common target dimension at $(1+\eta_1)D^*$.
